channel.title: Cboe BZX Exchange Approved and Immediately Effective Rule Filings
channel.description: The latest Cboe BZX Exchange Approved rule filings.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-066
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its Fees Schedule relating to the Options Regulatory Fee (ORF).

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-064
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend the free trial provisions for its End-of-Day (EOD) Open-Close Data, Ten-Minute Interval Intraday Open-Close Data, and One-Minute Interval Intraday Open-Close Data to replace the current participant-selected six-month historical data window with a fixed, uniform time range of July 1, 2022 through December 31, 2022 for all three products..

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-063
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its Fee Schedule by: (i) removing Step-Up Tier 2; (ii) adopting a new Single MPID Investor Tier; and (iii) removing the ETP and Closed-End Fund LMM Liquidity Provision Rates which expired on June 30, 2026.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-062
item.description: The Exchange proposes to introduce a Small Retail Broker Distribution Program for the BZX Top Data Feed.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-060
item.description: The Exchange proposes to introduce a Data Vendor Program, which includes introducing a new defined term of Data Vendor, along with other clarifying changes.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-058
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend the definition of Professional to require monthly reviews of orders.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-057
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend (1) the definition of Collar Price Range under Exchange Rule 11.23(a)(6) and to remove the existing Collar Midpoint definition therefrom; (2) Exchange Rule 11.23(a)(22) to adopt a standalone definition of the term Collar Midpoint that provides the Exchange with discretion to set the Collar Midpoint in any circumstance where no Volume Based Tie Breaker is available; and (3) Exchange Rule 11.23(d)(2)(F)(i) to separately articulate the price determination standards applicable to IPO Auctions in BZX-listed corporate securities and ETP IPO Auctions.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-055
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend Rule 11.23(a)(6) to permit provide the Exchange with explicit authority to adjust the issue price of a ETP IPO Security for purposes of applying the Collar Price Range to an ETP IPO Auction.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-054
item.description: The Exchange proposes to 1) amend the introductory paragraph of Rule 14.11(j) to add express cross-references to Rules 3.7 and 3.21; (2) delete Rule 14.11(j)(1) in its entirety, thereby removing the requirement that the Exchange distribute an information circular to Members prior to the commencement of trading in each UTP Derivative Security3 that generally includes the same information as contained in the information circular approved by the listing exchange; (3) amend Rule 14.11(j)(2)(B) to require that any written description be provided in a form approved by the listing exchange; and (4) renumber Rules 14.11(j)(2) through (5) as Rules 14.11(j)(1) through (4), respectively.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-052
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its Fee Schedule by removing the note appended to the Member Quoting Tier and MPID Quoting Tier.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-051
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its fee schedule applicable to its equities trading platform (BZX Equities) to modify the liquidity provision incentive structure applicable to the Exchanges lead market maker (LMM) program in BZX-listed exchange-traded product (ETP) securities as provided in footnote 14(B) of the fee schedule.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-050
item.description: The Exchange proposes to adopt fees for its new Clock Service.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-049
item.description: The Exchange proposes to adopt fees for its new Clock Service.

item.title: SR-CBOE-2026-048
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend Rule 8.30 (Position Limits), Interpretation and Policy .07 to increase the position and exercise limits1 for options on iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT).

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-048
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its Fee Schedule by: i) introducing two quoting tiers to its Add/Remove Volume Tiers and revising the criteria of Add Volume Tier 4; and ii) discontinuing Step-Up Tier 1.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-047
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its Fee Schedule to clarify that requests for mid-month subscriptions and ad-hoc historical requests for Open-Close Data will be prorated.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-043
item.description: The Exchange proposes to update Rule 11.26(a) regarding the public disclosure of the sources of data that the Exchange utilizes when performing: (i) order handling; (ii) order routing; (iii) order execution; and (iv) related compliance processes to reflect the planned operation of the Texas Stock Exchange LLC (TXSE) as a registered national securities exchange and to reflect the name change of Nasdaq BX, LLC to Nasdaq Texas, LLC.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-034
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend Chapter 8 of the Exchanges Rulebook relating to investigative and disciplinary matters.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-040
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend the Exchanges Fee Schedule to remove text capping the number of Dedicated Cores available to market participants.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-041
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its Fees Schedule to adopt a new fee code for Market-Maker Complex orders executed on the complex order book that add liquidity in Penny Program Securities and to amend its Orders Submitted with a Designated Give Up program.
